nom: PEACH & LILY Rescue Party Barrier Restore Serum

avis.texte: Great product with tons of skin barrier supporting ingredients! Love using this when my skin has a flare-up, it calms it down immediately :two_hearts:
So soothing! What an amazing product for helping your skin barrier :heartpulse:
This serum saved my skin from a harsh NY winter. It is healing, plumping. and moisturizing. Get it
This has been the only product that has cleared eczema on my face and neck, not even stuff from the dermatologist worked well. My skin feels relieved and looks better.

avis.titre: So good for your skin barrier!
avis.texte: Love this serum! It has an amazing ingredient list and does a great job at keeping my skin barrier strong plus the texture is so light and airy :heartpulse: I'm on at least my fifth bottle by now!

I have cystic inflammatory acne and this works so well to calm my skin down. I also have a sore in my ear from wearing ear plugs. I put a little on a q-tip and applied just right where the ear plugs hits and it calmed it right down.

avis.titre: Nice but not for the cost
avis.texte: This is a nice serum but it feels a bit watery, like you need to use more for it to be effective. The bottle feels small too so I think I'll go through it very quickly. It is nice but not worth the cost.

This is genuinely one of the best skincare products I've ever used. It doesn't bother my sensitive skin and it heals my blemishes quickly. My skin feels moisturized before I even use moisturizer. Great product!
Truly amazing, I immediately saw results and felt a difference in my skin. Creamy feel but absorbs in to the skin easily. I wont be letting this run out without a backup in my orders.

I try all the Peach and Lily serums, and this one has the biggest impact on skin comfort of them all. I hate the way my skin feels in Winter, dry rooms suck the moisture out and the cold temperatures sting. This serum really protects the integrity of the skin. I know this because my skin never gets that tight feeling at the end of the day when I apply it in the mornings.
Not only does this smooth and heal eczema- it helps heal your sore, red nose from constantly blowing your runny nose during cold and flu season.

after a couple weeks of using, my skin barrier definitely feels a difference. However, when I first opened the new bottle, the pump wasn't working because the straw was missing, so I had to decant the serum into another bottle.

Whenever I try a new acne product it always breaks me out but anytime I am breaking out and my skin looks rough cause I did something to ruin it, I use this and its better within a few hours. The cream also works wonders to heal your skin. 100% recommendation especially for sensitive skin!

this is the only product from peach&lily thats ever made me break out. it caused acne on my cheeks and fungal acne around my mouth. i couldnt figure out what was going on until i realized this was the only new product i had put on my face.

This serum is amazing for sensitive skin or when you need something to help with an irritated barrier. I originally tried the Cocokind ceramide serum but the added lactic acid did not help when my skin was already angry. This feels super nourishing and calming without any added oiliness and layers great with other products.
I like most of their products, but this one was a no for me. As soon as I apply it, my face turns red. There has to be something better, like maybe the avene cicalfate rescue cream.

avis.titre: Pump came stuck but product was good once fixed
avis.texte: Hydrating and texture was pretty nice underneath my moisturizer but given large P&L selection of serums, would likely not repurchase
This serum has been amazing at keeping my drier winter skin moistureized and soft!

The first time I bought this serum, I didn't think much of it. The consistency is very light; it does absorb quickly, but it didn't seem to be doing anything. Well, I recently had a bad breakout, my skin was red and irritated. In desperation, I went back to this serum in combination with the Rescue Party moisturizer. I could almost immediately tell a difference. My redness was calmed down significantly, which really improved the look of my skin. I will continue to use both products. As with all Peach and Lily products, you don't need much and I will say I am constantly tempted to use double the amount of this that I really need. If you have sensitive, inflamed skin, I'd give these Rescue Party products a try!

This cleared eczema on my eyelid in 2 days after trying several creams from the dermatologist. Overall my face looks more even toned and less dry. My skin looks so healthy now. I'm in my 40's with combination skin and still get breakouts, this did not clog my pores or cause any breakouts. This is by far my favorite serum.
Has a nice thick texture, very helpful for maintaining skin barrier while using Tretinoin. I have very sensitive skin and it does not cause any breakouts or irritation.
I love this serum. It helps keep my skin hydrated and its not sticking.

Unfortunately this product gave me a dry red rash on my cheekbones and forehead. I had breakout prior to using this and this product did help get rid of the acne, however after three days of using I noticed the rash and tight, dry skin.
Love this serum! I'm a repeat buyer! Worth purchasing for sure!
I love this product! My face has been less sensitive and more hydrated! Great for helping the barrier of my skin! Goodbye burning hello healthy!
This is a must have. Extremely hydrating and light weight. My skin does not feel dry and does not burn.
This serum helped clear signs of irritation on my face. I have really sensitive skin and it also helped with my sensitivity. I do feel like the rescue party cream works better though.

This, along with the moisturizer from the same line absolutely saved my skin. For reference I'm fair skin, that's also very sensitive, mature, acne prone, with rosacea….yay lol. I decided to try a popular brand AHA mask that completely ruined my skin. My skin was burned and I broke out with these tiny very painful pimples over my entire face, and it flared my rosacea to the worst it's been in years. I started using this serum with the moisturizer and after a week my skin was back to normal. 2 weeks later my skin is looking clear, hydrated, plump, and glowing. It does have a slight smell, but it doesn't last long. Highly recommend.

The holy grail of serums. Ever since I first started using this product I notice a huge difference in my skin's overall texture and appearance. My skin use to look dull and have opposing textures. Now, my skin looks like it's glowing and has no texture. It feels smooth and looks plump. If I could give this product more stars I would.

I never write reviews, but I am so thankful for this product. I switched from Peach and Lily oil cleanser to a popular one on socials. I got 3 of the cleansers at the ultra sale and when I ran out I reached for a cheaper alternative. Between the new cleaner and a serum I love being reformulated, my skin was worse than I had seen in a while. I repurchased the oil cleaner and went for this serum; simple, calm ingredients, hoping they would just bring the flare up down. I didn't see a lot of conversation around this product and I am not sure why because it is a dream. It has helped my skin more than just calming the flare up. Its so gentle, its like a little bubble wrap for my face. I have almost used up the bottle and will have to repurchase. Again, for the price point I struggle with repurchasing, but what I learned with my oil cleanser is there is nothing like peach and lily. (I even went to a K beauty store when in NYC and asked about products for crazy sensitive skin. We all decided this has to be one of the best)
This might be my new holy grail. Within a week I've noticed a decrease in texture, breakouts heal quicker and my complexion looks more glowy and even.

I had redness and dryness all over my face to the point that I can't even apply anything, including make up. Then came this product. Omgeee... In a span of few hours, my skin irritation remarkably decreased. My skin is glowing and plump! I did not recall experiencing w Gueralain, Lamer or Chanel. For reference, I am Asian and now a fan.

I absolutely adore Peach & Lily! the brand knows skin, their ingredients & performs very very well. I have never had any issues w/ any products causing an adverse reaction or any issues such as pilling when using with any other product. my only issue is the price. 1oz does not last a long time for a serum, considering 2 pumps can cover the whole face (apply to clean, damp skin for best absorption & even application) but ideally I need 3 pumps to cover face, neck & decolletage. & if u use this daily, twice a day, in all those areas, this bottle will not last that long, apx a month. I do believe that u get what u pay for though! but for what I get paid an hr, it's hard to incorporate this into my monthly budget with the other products I need. so I only use 2 pumps of this at night & apply to a moderately damp face to aid in spreading product evenly, all over. I do truly love it though, it has helped tremendously over the end of this past summer & predict is will be a great healing addition to winter dry, cracked skin!

This is a soothing serum and will play well with almost anything in your routine. While almost everything from P&L is my holy grail, this one didn't quite do it for me. It did feel very nice, but I didn't notice much of a difference without it. I would highly recommend the cream from this line instead.

Omg! So I dermaplaned my face a little too enthusiastically and had red, angry, parched skin to show for it. I had just gotten a sample of this serum and decided to try it out with my regular Clinique moisturizer over it. The redness and irritarion were completely gone in hours, and my skin was immediately calmed down upon applying it! This morning, my skin was plump, even-toned, and all the benefits of dermaplaning for my skin were enhanced (glowy, decreased lines, even texture). I can't believe how awesome my skin looks! I'm purchasing the full size of this serum to use from now after dermaplaning and any time my skin is irritated. I think it'll be especially helpful in the cold winter months. I keep looking in the mirror at my skin and will not be without this product again! :)

avis.titre: If you have sensitive skin this is a MUST
avis.texte: My skin has been so irritated the past year and everything burns. I tried First Aid Beauty, Nivea, Vanicream… everything and it burns. This product is the first that actually calms my skin! I'm in love!

avis.titre: BAR NONE THE BEST BARRIER REPAIR SERUM
avis.texte: This product has more ceramides than any other barrier support serum (I did the research) and more oatmeal than even the FAB cream. It's so healing! The Rescue Party stuff is definitely not for oily people. BUT IT WORKS!
The rescue moisturizer and serum made me break out and irritated my skin. I have very sensitive skin. Would not recommend

I have been on the market to find a replacement for my $145 medical grade facial hydrator, bc I work the vet field & just don't make that kinda cash. I am happy to announce this P&L product has been my saving grace. She checks all the boxes re: ingredients coupled w/ all the other bonuses such as Cruelty-Free & performance, etc. A perfect lightweight formula, absorbs w/ no greasy after feel & plays well w/ everyone. No pilling when layered w/ other products. She is that satisfying drink of water, er, serum, my skin is loving. & i am sensitive, acne prone WITH mature skin, but wow am I looking plump & glowy in the mornings now! I can not recommend this, or any other their products, enough. P&L groupie I proudly am!

I have very senstive skin and i started using this almost a month ago due to a distruped skin barrier. Over time my skin has inproved significantly. I use this a couple of times a week after chemical exfolixation in the morning now. No more burning when applying other products.

Its okay, but i feel like there are better products on the market. Its a pretty thin and milky consistency which is nice if you're into layering products. It doesnt feel too heavy and its comfortable. I didnt notice much redness reduction, but my face leans really red anyways, so i wasnt expecting much. When my skin is irritated, it does not exacerbate anything. It didnt burn, and feels nice to apply. The pump is not the best, and not a lot comes out because of how thin it is. Overall, its expensive for what it is and i dont find myself reaching for it. The pump should be so much better, especially for the price. However, if you dont have a product like this, it might be worth a try. Between this serum, and the peach and lily moisterizer by the same name, go for this serum. I preffered it a lot more than the cream.

The barrier serum and moisturizer paired together completely saved my skin after trying countless other products. I really wish the price could lower a little because I could simply use this for the rest of my life. I couldn't be more pleased with the results!!
Feels very smooth and easy to apply. I don't feel it on my skin. I am not sure if it helps much.

avis.titre: The barrier restore line saved my skin
avis.texte: My skin was running very dry in recent years, and someone gifted me a very potent retinol product recently that wrecked my skin. It was so bad that even applying moisturizer made my skin burn. I was DESPERATE. I couldnt really afford going to an esthetician regularly so I did some research and found this line which sounded like exactly what I needed without costing $100+ per product. I was hopeful but I did not expect THIS. My skin redness went down significantly, the itchiness, the burning, all started to go away. My skin feels supple, plump, and even moisturized! I feel like I was always looking for my perfect fit and I think I finally found it! I'm OBSESSED! Thank you Peach & Lily!!!

I have a very sensitive skin and can have breakouts out of nowhere. Since I live in a dry climate a proper hydration is very important for me. I'm a big fan of the Glass Skin Veil Mist and the Water- Gel Moisturizer, but sometimes they are not enough, so I decided to add the Restore Barrier serum to my routine and did't regret it. It's lightweight and very hydration at the same time and it works well for my picky skin.

I've received a couple free samples of this from different P&L promotions. I started using in my P&L routine when I have an outbreak, and it clears my skin up in 1-3 days!! It also appears to help with my dark spots, so this is a win-win for me. As far as price, it's in line with the rest of P&L products, so that's not a deterant for me. Will be buying the full-sized bottle and would recommend.

I was interested when this product came out because it sounded really good. After using it for a month it's not living up to its claims. I also hate the packaging. The pump doesn't want to work half the time.

avis.titre: THIS AND THE MOISTURIZER SAVED MY SKIN
avis.texte: My skin recently became ultra sensitive and reactive to things it was never before reactive to. I used some skincare I previously loved and it destroyed my skin. This serum and the barrier restore moisturizer saved my skin in as quick as 3 days!
This serum has creamy, milky, light texture. Instant hydration to the skin.

This serum saved my sensitive skin this winter after too many actives and a nasty wind burn. My gentlest moisturizers burned my skin and I wasn't tolerating anything. The first night I used this I woke up with 95% of the redness gone and no more burning with products. It has been a lifesaver for my sensitive skin as I have been revamping my skincare routine. This was my first peach and lily product I bought and I have quickly acquired more. This will always be one of my favorites!

i have dry-normal skin that isn't sensitive and rarely breaks out. however, when i used this product, after only 2 days i had a dry, red, rash develope on my skin. i stopped using the product immediately and the rash took about 1 week to heal.

avis.titre: Didn't realize how much my skin I needed this.
avis.texte: When I first started using this serum my skin absorbed it so fast. I was having to use 4 pumps and now I'm using what I usually would use. I've been using both the serum and cream of this set and it has changed my skin. My cheeks use to get so inflamed and irritated with bumps all over. Now I barely ever have that happen and if it does it's usually gone in the morning. I feel it has helped so much with my skin sensitivity. I have to still wear a mask all day at work and I can really tell a difference.
I love the product!! The pump was broken on mine when I got it though 😞

avis.titre: Not the Best Option For My Skin
avis.texte: As someone with rosacea and very sensitive skin I was so excited about this product, however after a few weeks of use it didn't really do anything for me. Everyone's skin is different it's just a matter of finding what works for you, so, while this isn't a great option for me, the ingredients are great and probably work well for others. Also, the dispenser is a little odd, I had to turn bottle upside down to get anything out.
Ever since I started using peach and lily products my skin has never been so clear! This serum gives me a glowy look and I love it

avis.titre: Great product but sadly too pricy
avis.texte: Love this serum so much and i may repurchase when i run out but the size and price are absolutely ridiculous.

I have sensitive skin and this is perfect! It's best used with another kind of barrier cream, though. I have combo skin and when using the Matcha Antioxidant Cream, my skin is too dry. But with the Barrier Cream, my skin is baby soft and my redness is almost nonexistent!! Definitely buying this again.
Need to try and stay consistent so that i can get more results. But it's been so amazing so far.

I like this product but can't quite tell how much it is working. I have extremely dry skin and it feels like it works right after I put it on but feel like the dry skin comes through still even after moisturizer. I may need to just give it time.
I wanted to love this serum but it caused a cystic acne breakout after less than one week. I was hoping this would work better than the moisturizer but both seem to clog my pores.

It's nice. It's not remarkable ( and the cocokind barrier serum is likely just as good ), but its okay. But the price is ridicukous. The pckaging feels cheap for the price, and considering I can get the same benefits from the cocokind serum, i wouldn't really go out of the way to buy.
The products I've been using have made a huge change in my routine. I have also noticed the change on my skin it is glowing, soft, and my hyperpigmentation is clearing up.

Wow! I got a sample of this serum at ulta as a gift and after using it a couple times i had to purchase the full size. My skin absolutely loved it and it has helped grealty with my dryness. All i can say is i will definitely repurchase, I'm just sad the bottle is so small.

This product feels so nice on the skin, and it leaves my face so hydrated throughout the day. it's not too thick and it does not pill when I apply makeup on top. I have sensitive dry skin, and it was so gentle and hydrating.
I bought the gel moisturizer and received a mini of this, ivn using it every night for the last 3/4 days and seen a HUGE improvement on my skin! Definitely purchasing the full size

Such a good serum! i bought the moisturizer as well, and they're both amazing. have definitely noticed significantly less redness, dryness and irritation. i love peach and lily and they did not miss with this!!
This serum also made me breakout in pustules! So disappointing.
This product is like a higher quality Aveeno and great for the skin barrier!

I love, love, love this serum! I'm 35, naturally oily skin that is very sensitive. I also break out and get clogged pores at the drop of a hat. I usually stay away from heavy lotions, because they can clog pores, but this serum is such a nice hydration booster! I use the P&L water gel moisturizer every day, with this serum underneath when I need a little extra (pretty much every day in the winter). I also use it at night, and it doesn't clog my pores. It's very soothing. Awesome!
I normally have irritated red skin when don't have enough rest. This helps soothe and calm my skin. Works great for me.

I'm so happy peach and Lilly came out with an essential oil free range for barrier repair and protecting. A lot of products for barrier repair claim to be fragrance free but then throw in essential oils which is super aggravating considering the majority of people will never have a reaction to synthetic fragrance, but ALOT more will get reactions to essential oils. But due to fear mongering in the beauty industry they put out essential oils for fragrance to say it's "clean" and then inevitably a lot of reaction reviews of ppl having no idea why they have red blotches everywhere. Anyway this is thin absorbs in about 20 seconds. It does not have a water to oil balance like I prefer in barrier repair products meaning there's no really emollient feel to it or good fatty oils close to the top of the inci to give it that extra bit of barrier protection. But it does what it says. Ceramides,cholesterol and fatty acids. The cream in this line is also great

avis.titre: Best barrier repairing serum out there
avis.texte: As someone with super sensitive skin and has wrecked their skin barrier many times, I've pretty much tried every ceramide/barrier repair serum on the market. I have never found one that didn't break me out, leave my oily skin feeling greasy or heavy, or just irritate my skin (the exact opposite of what it's meant to do!) So when Peach and Lily released this serum, I had to try it and I am so impressed! The texture is lovely, super milky and feels nourishing but still lightweight enough to sink into the skin easily with no tacky residue. It leaves my skin looking and feeling soft, soothed and healthy, plus I haven't had any irritation since using this product and my redness has been reduced! It plays well with my other skincare products and under makeup, no pilling, so I use it morning and night. I'm completely in love with this serum and will definitely be a staple in my routine from now on!

I had never experience facial eczema until a couple of weeks ago. It was wildly itchy, raised, red, and flaky across my lower face, neck, and deck. I tried a number of different skincare products, many of which tout "moisturizing" properties…but nothing helped, it was getting worse. I bought both items from the Rescue Party line and within a few hours I could tell it was helping. Within a couple of days of using both the serum and moisturizer, my eczema was just about entirely cleared and I am completely relived of the wildly annoying itching. This will not be a part of my regular routine (much of which is already Peach and Lily) so I can continue to keep my skin barrier as strong as possible!
